texts.zh:
一个神秘的太空舱飘在[from.GetName]中。它看起来没有任何攻击能力并且对我们的信号毫无反应。

初步扫描显示它受损的外部是用先进的材料和陌生的工程科技建造的。需要进一步分析。
texts.en:
A mysterious capsule is adrift in [from.GetName]. It has no obvious offensive capability and is unresponsive to our signals.

Initial scans show that its damaged exterior is constructed using advanced materials and unfamiliar engineering techniques. Further analysis is needed.

texts.zh: 一个明显受损的神秘胶囊正在飘过[this.GetName]星系。我们不知道它的起源，也对其功能一无所知。它看起来不具备明显的武器，我们相信对其先进的建造工艺进行分析是一个安全和值得投入的项目。
texts.en: A mysterious and visibly-damaged capsule is drifting through the [this.GetName] system. We know neither its origin nor function. It possesses no evident weaponry and we believe further analysis of its advanced construction would be a safe and worthwhile venture.

texts.zh:
[this.leader.GetName]相信飘过[solar_system.GetName]星系的神秘太空舱是一种古老的“风暴陷阱”，可能曾是一个更大的防御系统的一部分。

这个设备的进气口密封得很紧，但我们的扫描显示它里面藏有被俘获其中的高度压缩的宇宙风暴能量和物质。

研究如何这个非凡的容器可能会教会我们很多关于抑制风暴的知识，但也有释放其蕴含的所有能量的风险。
texts.en:
[this.leader.GetName] believes that the mysterious capsule drifting through the [solar_system.GetName] system is an ancient "storm trap", which may have once been part of a larger defense grid.

The device's intake port is sealed tightly, but our readings suggest it is holding the compressed energy and matter of a captive cosmic storm inside.

Finding a way to open this remarkable container may teach us a great deal about storm mitigation, although at the risk of releasing whatever forces are currently contained within.

label.zh: 这里有很多值得学习的东西。
label.en: There is much to learn here.

texts.zh: 一个古老的“风暴陷阱”在太空中自由漂流，内部携带着压缩的宇宙风暴。打开它将为风暴管理和缓解提供宝贵的洞见，但代价是释放被困在里面的未知力量。
texts.en: An ancient "storm trap" is drifting freely through space, carrying a compressed cosmic storm within. Opening it would provide valuable insights into storm management and mitigation, at the risk of releasing whatever forces are trapped inside.

texts.zh:
[leader.GetName]完成了对古老风暴陷阱工作原理的分析，并解开了其输入装置。随着端口打开，[from.GetStormType]内部的风暴被释放到[solar_system.GetName]星系的虚空中。

对陷阱复杂工程的研究已经对抗风暴材料和结构产生了惊人的洞见，尽管我们仍然不明白这个装置是如何能够完全控制风暴的。这些知识将极大地帮助我们抵御未来的宇宙扰动。
texts.en:
[leader.GetName] completed analysis of the ancient storm trap's workings and was able to unlock its intake mechanism. As the ports opened, the [from.GetStormType] held inside was released into the void of the [solar_system.GetName] system.

Study of the trap's complex engineering has produced fascinating insights into storm-resistant materials and structures, though we still do not understand how the device is capable of containing storms entirely. This knowledge will greatly aid us in weathering future cosmic disturbances.

summary.text:
# 漂泊胶囊 / Drifting Capsule

- 分类 Category: C8 银河轶事 / C8 Galactic miscellany · 来源 Sources: events/cosmic_storms_events_1.txt:4008-4262; common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:5509; common/special_projects/03_projects_cosmic_storms.txt:839 · DLC: Cosmic Storms · 审阅 Reviewed 2026-10-13

## 如何开始 How it starts

首次遭遇风暴后约1800天（5年），隐藏事件 cstorms.1815 在境内选一个系统（游牧帝国则在驿站所在系统）弹出“漂泊胶囊”。

About 1800 days (5 years) after the first storm encounter, hidden cstorms.1815 picks a system inside the borders (the waystation system for nomads) and shows the "Drifting Capsule".

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

cstorms.1816/1817 启用“研究胶囊”项目；完成后 cstorms.1820“风暴陷阱”：选a获得工程研究并启用“打开风暴陷阱”项目；选b获得工程研究、团结和影响力后结束。陷阱项目成功后隐藏事件 cstorms.1825 随机生成六种风暴之一，cstorms.1826“风暴释放”给工程研究、风暴破坏者船体科技进度和洞察修正。

cstorms.1816/1817 enable the "Study the Capsule" project; when done cstorms.1820 "Storm Trap": option a gives engineering research and enables the "Open the storm trap" project; option b gives engineering research, unity and influence and ends. When the trap project succeeds hidden cstorms.1825 spawns one of six storm types at random and cstorms.1826 "Storm Released" grants engineering research, storm-breaker hull tech progress and an insight modifier.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

1816/1817 二选一取决于是否为游牧；1820 的 a/b 互斥；1825 在六种风暴中等权随机。

1816/1817 depend on nomad status; 1820 a/b are exclusive; 1825 is an equal-weight roll over six storm types.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

Cosmic Storms DLC。

Cosmic Storms DLC.
